item.title: Police Scotland Reinforces Travel Advice as Snow and Ice Warnings Extended
item.description: Snow and ice warnings have been extended across northern Scotland, with Police Scotland urging caution as hazardous driving conditions are expected, highlighting the importance of planning journeys carefully and staying informed as winter weather continues to disrupt travel.The post Police Scotland Reinforces Travel Advice as Snow and Ice Warnings Extended appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Number of Baby Boxes Delivered in 2025 Revealed
item.description: Thousands of Scottish families received Baby Boxes in 2025, marking a major milestone for a programme designed to give every child the best start in life, with further enhancements planned to strengthen early years support and reduce the impact of poverty.The post Number of Baby Boxes Delivered in 2025 Revealed appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Appeal Launched After Pedestrian Airlifted From A82 Crash
item.description: Police Scotland is appealing for witnesses after a serious crash on the A82 at Bridge of Oich left a woman with serious injuries, with officers urging drivers to check dash cam footage as enquiries continue.The post Appeal Launched After Pedestrian Airlifted From A82 Crash appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: No Blue Mondays Here as Lidl Revives Little Christmas With £6 Treat for Scots
item.description: Lidl is bringing a touch of Scottish tradition to January by reviving Little Christmas, offering 1,000 shoppers a £6 voucher while celebrating Nollaig Bheag and its deep cultural roots during a month many find difficult.The post No Blue Mondays Here as Lidl Revives Little Christmas With £6 Treat for Scots appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: World Cup Bank Holiday Proposed as Scotland Prepares for Historic Return
item.description: Scotland could mark its return to the men’s World Cup with a national bank holiday in June 2026, as political leaders back plans to let the country celebrate a historic sporting moment and Scotland’s first appearance on the world stage since 1998.The post World Cup Bank Holiday Proposed as Scotland Prepares for Historic Return appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Join Spring Clean Scotland as Volunteers Rally to Tackle Litter Nationwide
item.description: Spring Clean Scotland returns from March to April 2026, calling on volunteers, communities and businesses to tackle litter nationwide, as new figures show strong public concern and growing momentum to protect Scotland’s environment.The post Join Spring Clean Scotland as Volunteers Rally to Tackle Litter Nationwide appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Nominations Re Open in Buckie and Findochty Community Councils
item.description: Nominations have re opened for community councils in Buckie and Findochty, giving local residents a renewed chance to stand, strengthen representation, and help shape decision making in their communities ahead of the new term.The post Nominations Re Open in Buckie and Findochty Community Councils appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Arctic Cold Grips The Highlands as Snow and Ice Continue to Disrupt Travel
item.description: Severe winter weather continues to affect the Highlands as Arctic cold brings deep snow, ice and travel disruption, with councils and emergency services urging caution while further snow and hazardous conditions remain possible this week.The post Arctic Cold Grips The Highlands as Snow and Ice Continue to Disrupt Travel appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Independence Can Deliver a Kinder and Fairer Scotland Says SNP Candidate
item.description: The SNP has launched its 2026 campaign with calls for independence, as candidate Eilidh Munro argues Scotland can build a kinder, fairer and more prosperous future by choosing a different path from Westminster politics.The post Independence Can Deliver a Kinder and Fairer Scotland Says SNP Candidate appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Amber Snow Warnings Issued Across Highlands and Grampians
item.description: Amber snow warnings have been issued for the Highlands and Grampians as further heavy snowfall is forecast, with Police Scotland urging caution and communities warned to expect travel disruption, hazardous conditions and potential service interruptions.The post New Amber Snow Warnings Issued Across Highlands and Grampians appeared first on The Highland Times.
